verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents a first-party MCP server that lets an agent read and modify collections, requests, environments, and teams and send real HTTP requests, plus a CLI for terminal/automated interaction (running tests, managing collections) — both are officially documented programmatic interfaces suited to AI-native/agentic use. Missing for 10: a general public REST/OpenAPI API for the platform itself (probe found openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), so agentic access is limited to the MCP/CLI surface rather than a broader documented API.
